disclaimer: These numbers are estimates, not medical advice. If you have a chronic condition, are pregnant or breastfeeding, talk to a doctor first.

auth.title: Fitness Trainer
auth.tagline: Food, water and workouts in one place. Targets are calculated for your body and goal.
auth.toSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.guestHint: Your data stays on this device only. You can create an account later.
auth.notConfigured: The server isn't connected yet, so sign-in is unavailable. You can use the app without an account.
auth.checkEmail: We sent an email to {{email}}. Open the link in it to confirm your account.

errors.invalidCredentials: Email or password doesn't match. Check them and try again.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.weakPassword: Password is too short. Use at least 8 characters.
errors.invalidEmail: This address looks mistyped. Example: name@gmail.com
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Couldn't sign in. Try again in a minute.

about.title: About you
about.subtitle: Sex and age affect your basal metabolic rate.

body.title: Height and weight
body.subtitle: Weigh yourself in the morning before eating.

activityStep.title: Activity
activityStep.subtitle: Pick based on a typical week, workouts included.

goalStep.title: Goal
goalStep.subtitle: Calories are based on what you burn in a day.

sedentary.title: Sedentary
sedentary.desc: Desk job, little movement, no workouts

light.title: Lightly active
light.desc: 1–3 workouts a week or lots of walking

lose.title: Lose weight
lose.desc: Calorie deficit, more protein to keep muscle

gain.title: Build muscle
gain.desc: A small surplus for muscle growth

result.title: Your daily targets
result.tdee: With your activity you burn ≈ {{value}} kcal a day.
result.adjustmentNone: For your goal, calories match what you burn.
result.weekly: Expected weight change: {{value}} kg per week.

warnings.clamped_to_minimum: Raised to a safe minimum. Below this it's hard to get enough nutrients.
warnings.fast_loss: A fast pace is hard to sustain and costs muscle along with fat. A moderate pace works better.
warnings.fast_gain: With fast gain, most of it is fat. A moderate pace builds more muscle.
warnings.underweight_loss: Your weight is already below normal (BMI < 18.5). Losing weight isn't recommended — talk to a doctor.
warnings.minor: Under 18 your needs are different. Talk to a doctor or coach before changing your diet.

today.weighInHint: Weigh yourself in the morning. Targets follow your weight trend, not a single reading.
today.targetsUpdated: Your weight trend changed, so your target is now {{kcal}} kcal.

nutrition.title: Food
nutrition.emptyDayBody: Log what you eat by search, barcode or a meal photo. The rings show what’s left for today.

workouts.title: Workouts
workouts.emptyBody: Answer a few questions and get a program for your goal, experience and gym equipment.
workouts.deload: Deload week: fewer sets, same weight

progress.title: Progress
progress.emptyBody: Log your weight on the Today tab and charts and a weekly report will show up here.
progress.weightSub: Dots are weigh-ins, the line is the 7-day trend
progress.noMeasurements: Measure waist, chest, biceps and hips every 1–2 weeks to see changes the scale won't show.
progress.noPhotos: A monthly photo in the same pose and light is the most honest way to see change.
progress.noStrength: Charts appear after strength calibration or a few workouts.
progress.heatmapSub: Sets this week: primary muscle 1, secondary 0.5. For growth aim for 10–20.

food.searchLabel: Search for a dish or product
food.remoteError: External databases are unavailable right now. Results from the app's database are above.
food.remoteOffline: Open Food Facts and USDA search works when you're signed in.
food.noResultsHint: Try another name or add the product yourself from its label.
food.approx: Approximate values for a standard recipe.
food.deleteBody: The entry and its calories will be removed from this day.
food.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted. Go back to search and pick another one.
food.newHint: Values per 100 g — you'll find them on the label.
food.name: Name
food.macrosMismatch: Calories don't match the macros: macros give ≈ {{kcal}} kcal. Check the label.

recipe.name: Recipe name
recipe.noIngredients: Add ingredients and the nutrition is calculated for you.
recipe.cookedWeightHint: Weigh the finished dish: cooking adds or removes water, which changes nutrition per 100 g. Optional.
recipe.deleteBody: Diary entries stay, but the recipe disappears from search.
recipe.emptyBody: Build a dish from ingredients once, then log it by the serving.

beginner.title: Beginner
beginner.desc: Less than 6 months of regular training

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.desc: Over 2 years, solid technique on the main lifts

programNew.title: New program
programNew.replaceWarn: Your current program will be replaced. Workout history stays.
programNew.noStrength: No strength levels yet — in the first workouts you'll pick weights by feel. You can calibrate now.

strength.title: Strength levels
strength.intro: Enter the weight and reps of any recent set taken close to failure. We'll estimate your one-rep max (1RM).
strength.levelHint: For lifts without data we'll use starting weights for your level — they get refined after your first workouts.
strength.tooManyReps: Over 15 reps isn't reliable. Enter a heavier set.
strength.formula: Up to 10 reps uses the Epley formula, 11–15 uses Brzycki. Your 1RM updates after every workout.
strength.pullupHint: Enter added weight (0 if none). We'll add your body weight.

gym.title: My gym
gym.intro: Mark what your gym has — the program will use only this equipment.
gym.name: Gym name
gym.namePlaceholder: For example, the gym near home

exercises.title: Exercise catalog
exercises.empty: Nothing found. Try another name or clear the filter.

live.rpeHint: 10 — no reps left, 8 — two in reserve

hint.increase: You hit every rep last time — weight increased
hint.repeat: Same weight, try to add reps
hint.decrease: Weight lowered after two hard sessions in a row
hint.none: Pick a weight: the last reps should be hard, with 1–2 in reserve

live.swapForever: Replace in the program for good
live.noSets: Mark at least one set as done

workoutDetail.deleteBody: The sets will be removed from history. 1RM estimates won't change.

photo.title: Meal photo
photo.intro: Take a photo of the plate from above so all the food is visible. We'll estimate weight and nutrition, and you'll check it before saving.
photo.hintPlaceholder: For example, borscht with sour cream
photo.lowConfidence: Recognition isn't confident. Check names and weights and correct them if needed.
photo.fromDb: nutrition from the Ukrainian dishes database
photo.empty: All items removed. Take another photo or add food manually.

errors.notConfigured: Photo recognition works in the claude.ai version. Here, add food via search.
errors.upload: Couldn't upload the photo. Check your connection and try again.
errors.refused: This photo couldn't be processed. Try another one or add food manually.
errors.busy: The recognition service is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.tooLarge: The photo is too large. Try taking it again.
errors.notFood: No food visible in the photo. Take a closer photo of the plate.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Couldn't recognise the meal. Try again or add food manually.
errors.artifactDenied: Photo recognition is off here: Claude access isn't allowed for this artifact. You can turn it on in the artifact's Permissions menu.
errors.badType: This isn’t a photo. Use JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC.

photo.permission: To photograph food, allow camera access in your phone settings.
photo.artifactNote: In this version Claude recognises the photo through your claude.ai account: it asks for permission the first time, and requests use your Claude limit.

barcode.title: Barcode
barcode.intro: Point the camera at the barcode or type the digits under it.
barcode.invalid: This code looks mistyped: the check digit doesn't match. Check the digits.
barcode.notFound: No product with code {{code}} in Open Food Facts.
barcode.notFoundHint: Add it yourself from the label — next time it'll be found by this code.
barcode.error: Couldn't check the barcode. Check your connection and try again.
barcode.webHint: Camera scanning works in the phone app. Here, type the digits under the barcode.
barcode.permission: The camera is needed to scan barcodes.
barcode.offline: Open Food Facts isn't available in this demo. Add the product yourself from its label — next time it will be found by this code.

measure.title: Measurements
measure.intro: Measure in the morning with a tape, without pulling it tight, in the same spots each time.

photosScreen.title: Before and after photos
photosScreen.private: Photos are private: they are stored in your personal space and nobody else can see them. Before saving, photos are downsized and location data (EXIF) is removed.
photosScreen.empty: No photos from this angle yet.
photosScreen.deleteBody: The photo will be removed from this device and from cloud storage.
photosScreen.error: Couldn’t save the photo. Use JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC up to 20 MB.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.intro: Local notifications on your phone. Turn each on separately.
reminders.webOnly: Reminders work in the phone app. They can't be set up in the browser.
reminders.denied: Notifications are turned off in phone settings. Allow them for the app to get reminders.

water.title: Water
water.desc: Every 2 hours until 20:00, starting at the chosen time
water.notifBody: A glass now gets you closer to your target.

meal.title: Food diary
meal.desc: Once a day, to log what you ate
meal.notifBody: A couple of minutes and today's diary is complete.

workout.title: Workout
workout.notifBody: Your program is waiting. Warm up and go.

weigh_in.title: Weigh-in
weigh_in.desc: Every morning, for an accurate trend
weigh_in.notifBody: Mornings before eating are the most accurate.

data.title: Saving and transfer
data.saveError: Couldn’t save. Will retry on the next change.
data.modeAccount: Your data is stored in your claude.ai account and opens on any device. Other people with the link can’t see it.
data.modeReadonly: You have view-only access, so data stays in this browser only. Ask the owner for Contributor access to keep it in your account.
data.modeDevice: Your data is stored on this device.
data.resetBody: This deletes: profile and targets, food diary, water, strength numbers, My gym, program and workouts, measurements and photos, reminders and settings. It can’t be undone, so export first.
data.importBody: Sections present in the file will be fully replaced with its contents. Current data in those sections will be lost.
data.nativeHint: File export and import currently work in the web version.

importErrors.wrongFormat: This file doesn’t look like an export from this app.
importErrors.newerVersion: This file comes from a newer app version. Reload the page and try again.
